user_job: guide a small companion home along a remembered trail
signature_device: unequal ear tufts and two broad edge-open wing gouges define a full-body owl
notes: The marten became a generic running animal and the side-view owl became origami. The third pass moves the horned owl's unequal ear tufts, broad breast, and split tail into the outer contour; two edge-open gouges now read as relief cuts without naming the bird.
